programs.title: Tough Tested
programs.desc: The Highclere Caravans take on the X-Series RV and Sunland Caravans in a series of challenges; the Vantec Caravan Graveyard tests each caranvan's endurance by focusing on their advanced suspension systems.

programs.title: Reel Action
programs.desc: Lake Awoonga is an amazing impoundment heavily stocked with one of Australia's sportfish the mighty Barramundi! Evan Speer from Lake Awoonga Barra Charters joins the team to try and land a fish.

programs.title: Escape Fishing With ET
programs.desc: Part 2 at Swains Reef. Non stop action, Spanish Mackerel, shark mackerel, monster GT's, long toms. Fishing's red hot and every cast hooks up. Absolute chaos out here!

programs.title: IFISH
programs.desc: Paul learns the art of beach worming from local Ulladulla guru Roger Osborne who helps Paul prove the point that when it comes to bait, fresh is always best.

programs.title: On The Fly
programs.desc: Join Gavin as he teams up with Matt Stone from Trout Tales Tasmania on one of the state's premier trout lakes. Set in the iconic highland region, this early-season adventure demands readiness.
